name: Session History
description: Contributes the SessionHistory tool: paginated, filterable read access to any saved session's transcript (this one or a past one) from the append-only JSONL store. Window records, list/search sessions, filter tool calls by name, read spilled tool-output blobs, or produce the full markdown/XML dump. Reads only through the ctx.host capability surface (sessions:read, blobs:read). Distinct from SessionInfo, which reports the current run's live state.

tool.name: SessionHistory
tool.description: Read the recorded conversation history of a session from the on-disk transcript store (~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.jsonl), this session's earlier turns or any past one. The archival counterpart to SessionInfo (which reports live runtime state: context %, quota, cost). Actions: 'window' (default) pages records with stable indexes, newest 10 by default (anchor 'end'), and anchor 'start' + offset/limit walks forward. 'meta' summarizes a session (model, cwd, created, record counts, first prompt, liveness). 'list' enumerates saved sessions newest-first (filter by query/cwd). 'search' greps text across one session (sid set) or recent sessions (sid omitted). 'tool_calls' filters invocations by tool name. 'blob' reads one tool call's full pre-truncation output by tool_use_id. 'dump' renders the whole session as markdown or XML (large, prefer 'window'). sid defaults to 'last' and accepts any unique id prefix (e.g. '260d72dd'). Results are bounded: previews clip per record and each response reports totals plus next-page offsets.

sid.description: Target session id, full id or any unique prefix (e.g. '260d72dd'), or 'last' (default) for the most recent session in this cwd (falling back to the globally most recent). An ambiguous prefix errors with the matching candidates. Not needed for 'list', optional for 'search'.

anchor.description: window: page from the oldest record ('start') or the newest ('end', default).

offset.description: window/list/search/tool_calls: records to skip from the anchor. Default 0.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults: window 10 (max 500), list 25, search 20, tool_calls 20.

previewChars.description: window/search: per-record body clip in characters. Default 600 (window) / 160 (search).

query.description: search: case-insensitive substring to find. list: filter sessions by sid/cwd substring.

cwd.description: list: only sessions whose recorded cwd equals this path.

tool.description: tool_calls: only invocations of this tool name (e.g. 'Bash'). Omit for all tools.

toolUseId.description: blob: the tool_use id whose raw spilled output to read.

maxBytes.description: blob: clamp the returned blob text to this many bytes. Default 65536.

tool.reason: perfect collision: plugin IS the tool name
